decisions.statement: A return path is read as a path of the peripheral's own or thrown away.
A return path naming the landing path or the sign-in path is thrown away.
A code that reads as nobody sends the person back to alanwalton.com rather than signing anyone in.
The cookie is set on the redirect that carries the person to the return path.

definition: taking a code at a peripheral's landing path, and sending a stranger off to get one
